source_metadata.title: Odontogenic Orofacial Space Infections
source_metadata.source_type: StatPearls narrative clinical review / continuing education chapter
source_metadata.drive_file: Odontogenic Orofacial Space Infections - StatPearls - NCBI Bookshelf.pdf
source_metadata.current_ncbi_last_update: 2023-07-12 (externally verified; source PDF itself does not print the date)

extraction.batching: single pass; 11 pages / ~4,045 words; bibliography excluded from atomization except disclosures and figure caption

notes: No exact duplicate canonical statements or repeated anchors were retained. Related clinical claims were preserved when they represented distinct assertions.

schema_gaps: The LiteratureAtom schema is designed for primary literature and has no dedicated atom kind for narrative-review clinical recommendations or secondary evidence summaries.
Most review assertions are therefore serialized as atom_kind=other with descriptive tags rather than being forced into quantitative_result or primary-study result kinds.
Secondary-reported numeric claims were not converted into quantitative_result atoms because doing so would require artificial population/exposure/outcome fields not supplied by this review.
extraction_limitations: This is a secondary StatPearls review, not a primary study; atoms represent what the review reports, not independent verification of cited primary evidence.
The PDF includes one clinical photograph and no main-text tables or formal algorithms.
Bibliographic entries were used to build the separate reference task queue and were not atomized as evidence.
The PDF front matter visibly lists Jacob E. Hoerter; Benjamin D. Malkin appears in the disclosures and current NCBI metadata.
